svg.title: AI decision accuracy per opponent
svg.desc: Chance the CPU plays its best move, per opponent. 01: JANUARY CRANE: easy 20%, hard 50%, master 78%. 02: FEB. WARBLER: easy 23%, hard 52%, master 80%. 03: MARCH CURTAIN: easy 27%, hard 55%, master 82%. 04: APRIL CUCKOO: easy 30%, hard 58%, master 84%. 05: MAY BRIDGE: easy 34%, hard 60%, master 86%. 06: JUNE SWARM: easy 38%, hard 63%, master 88%. 07: JULY BOAR: easy 41%, hard 66%, master 90%. 08: AUGUST MOON: easy 45%, hard 69%, master 92%. 09: SEPT. SAKE: easy 49%, hard 71%, master 94%. 10: OCT. DEER: easy 52%, hard 74%, master 96%. 11: NOV. RAIN: easy 56%, hard 77%, master 98%. 12: DEC. PHOENIX: easy 60%, hard 80%, master 100%. ENTITY 13 // DEUS SUPREMUS: 100% on every band.
svg.text: how often the CPU plays its best move - read live from ai_get_accuracy() in src/ai.c
the art under each column is his signature target, from the roster in src/cards.c
the 15s/30s timer, the ruleset and the mono DEUS SUPREMUS atlas change your pressure, not his accuracy
